CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digest_period_skips (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 period_start DATE NOT NULL,
 period_end DATE NOT NULL,
 reason VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
 skipped_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 skipped_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT uq_digest_period_skips_period UNIQUE (client_id, period_start, period_end),
 CONSTRAINT ck_digest_period_skips_period CHECK (period_end >= period_start),
 CONSTRAINT ck_digest_period_skips_reason CHECK (char_length(btrim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 300)
)
